verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.modern: From Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus —

verses.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.modern: to Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace to You from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.modern: I thank God — whom I serve, as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience — as I remember You constantly in my prayers night and day.

verses.kjv: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.modern: I long to see You. I remember Your tears, and I want to be filled with joy.

verses.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.modern: I am reminded of the sincere faith that is in You — the faith that first lived in Your grandmother Lois and in Your mother Eunice, and which, I am persuaded, lives in You also.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.modern: For this reason I remind You to stir up the gift of God which is in You through the laying on of my hands.

verses.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.modern: For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

verses.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.modern: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me His prisoner. Instead, share in the afflictions of the gospel, according to the power of God.

verses.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
verses.modern: He has saved us and called us with a holy calling — not because of our works, but because of His own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

verses.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.modern: and which is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, Who has abolished death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

verses.kjv: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.modern: I was appointed a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles for this gospel.

verses.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.modern: And that is why I suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed — for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to keep what I have committed to Him against that day.

verses.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.modern: Hold fast the pattern of sound words which You have heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verses.modern: Guard that good thing which was committed to You — by the Holy Ghost Who dwells in us.

verses.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.modern: You know this, that all those who are in Asia have turned away from me, among whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

verses.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.modern: May the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for He often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.

verses.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
verses.modern: When He was in Rome, He searched for me diligently and found me.

verses.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
verses.modern: May the Lord grant that He find mercy from the Lord on that day! And You know very well how many ways He ministered to me at Ephesus.

chapters.summary: Paul writes to his beloved son Timothy, thanking God for Timothy's unfeigned faith and urging him not to be ashamed of the testimony of the Lord nor of Paul as His prisoner. He reminds Timothy that God has not given us the spirit of fear but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind, and charges him to hold fast the pattern of sound words.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.modern: You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.modern: And the things that You have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses — commit these to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: You therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.modern: No soldier on active duty gets entangled in the affairs of civilian life — his aim is to please the one who enlisted him.

verses.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.modern: And if a man competes as an athlete, he is not crowned unless He competes by the rules.

verses.kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.modern: The hardworking farmer must be the first to share in the crops.

verses.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.modern: Consider what I say, and the Lord give You understanding in all things.

verses.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.modern: Remember that Jesus Christ, of the seed of David, was raised from the dead, according to my gospel —

verses.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.modern: for which I suffer trouble, even as a criminal, to the point of chains. But the word of God is not chained.

verses.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.modern: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

verses.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.modern: This is a faithful saying: If we died with Him, we shall also live with Him;

verses.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.modern: if we endure, we shall also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He also will deny us;

verses.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.modern: if we are faithless, He remains faithful — He cannot deny Himself.

verses.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.modern: Remind them of these things, charging them before the Lord not to quarrel about words. It accomplishes nothing — it only ruins those who listen.

verses.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.modern: Study to show Yourself approved to God, a workman who does not need to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

verses.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.modern: Shun profane and empty chatter, for it will lead to more and more ungodliness.

verses.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.modern: And their word will eat away like a canker — among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

verses.kjv: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.modern: who have strayed from the truth, saying that the resurrection has already happened, and they overthrow the faith of some.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, the foundation of God stands firm, having this seal: "The Lord knows those who are His," and, "Let every one who names the name of Christ depart from iniquity."

verses.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.modern: In a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay — some for honor and some for dishonor.

verses.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.modern: So if anyone cleanses himself from these things, he will be a vessel for honor — sanctified, useful for the Master, prepared for every good work.

verses.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.modern: Flee youthful lusts. Pursue righteousness, faith, charity, and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

verses.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.modern: Avoid foolish and ignorant arguments, knowing that they breed strife.

verses.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.modern: And the servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but gentle to all, able to teach, patient,

verses.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.modern: in meekness instructing those who oppose themselves — God perhaps will grant them repentance, so that they may come to the acknowledging of the truth,

verses.kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
verses.modern: and they may come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.

chapters.summary: Paul charges Timothy to be strong in grace and to endure hardness as a good soldier of Jesus Christ, committing what he has heard to faithful men who can teach others. He instructs Timothy to study to show himself approved unto God, a workman that needs not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth, and to flee youthful lusts while pursuing righteousness, faith, charity, and peace.

verses.kjv: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.modern: Know this also: in the last days, perilous times shall come.

verses.kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.modern: For men shall be lovers of themselves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

verses.kjv: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.modern: without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, without self-control, fierce, despisers of those who are good,

verses.kjv: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
verses.modern: traitors, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God —

verses.kjv: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.modern: having a form of godliness, but denying its power. From such people turn away.

verses.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
verses.modern: For of this sort are those who creep into houses and lead captive silly women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

verses.kjv: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.modern: ever learning, but never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

verses.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.modern: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so these also resist the truth — men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

verses.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
verses.modern: But they shall proceed no further, for their folly shall be made manifest to all men — as theirs also was.

verses.kjv: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.modern: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

verses.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.modern: persecutions, afflictions — what came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured. But out of them all the Lord delivered me.

verses.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.modern: Yes, and all who will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

verses.kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.modern: But evil men and impostors shall grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

verses.kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
verses.modern: But You continue in the things which You have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom You have learned them —

verses.kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.modern: and that from childhood You have known the holy scriptures, which are able to make You wise to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.modern: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,

verses.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.modern: that the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished for every good work.

chapters.summary: Paul warns that in the last days perilous times shall come, with men being lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, and lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God. He reminds Timothy that all who will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution, and declares that all scripture is given by inspiration of God and is profitable for doctrine, reproof, correction, and instruction in righteousness.

verses.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.modern: I charge You therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, Who shall judge the quick and the dead at His appearing and His kingdom:

verses.kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verses.modern: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and doctrine.

verses.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.modern: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine, but according to their own lusts they shall heap up for themselves teachers, having itching ears.

verses.kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.modern: They shall turn away their ears from the truth and be turned to fables.

verses.kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
verses.modern: But watch in all things; endure afflictions; do the work of an evangelist; make full proof of Your ministry.

verses.kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.modern: For I am now ready to be poured out as an offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.

verses.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.modern: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.

verses.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.modern: From now on there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day — and not to me only, but to all them also that love His appearing.

verses.kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.modern: Do Your diligence to come to me shortly.

verses.kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.modern: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and has departed to Thessalonica; Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

verses.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.modern: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

verses.kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.modern: I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

verses.kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.modern: When you come, bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, and the books — especially the parchments.

verses.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.modern: Alexander the coppersmith did me much harm. The Lord will repay Him according to His works.

verses.kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.modern: Be on guard against him yourself, for he has greatly opposed our words.

verses.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.modern: At my first defense no one stood with me — all forsook me. May it not be charged against them.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.modern: But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that through me the preaching might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.modern: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me to His heavenly kingdom. To Him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.modern: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.modern: Erastus stayed at Corinth, but I left Trophimus sick at Miletum.

verses.kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.modern: Do your diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brethren.

verses.kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.modern: The Lord Jesus Christ be with Your spirit. Grace be with You. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul charges Timothy to preach the word in season and out of season, warning that the time will come when men will not endure sound doctrine but will heap to themselves teachers having itching ears. Paul declares that he has fought a good fight, finished his course, and kept the faith, and that a crown of righteousness is laid up for him which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give him at that day.
